pages.scope: ZFC forcing over transitive grounds, with stronger conditions smaller. Closure, distributivity, chain conditions, nice names, Cohen and collapse orders are separated before the continuum computations. Semantic generic extensions and PA-formalized finite-fragment consistency transfer remain distinct. Ordinary forcing preserves ground-model AC; no failure-of-choice branch is asserted.

pages.authoring_notes: Do not consume rem-independence-of-ch-and-gch: it is the Recorded target. Preserve the distinction between ordinal preservation, ccc cardinal/cofinality preservation, and closure preservation. The formal compiler is mandatory; a CTM narrative alone does not prove the Con implications. Easton is orientation only.

AC uses in bookkeeping, antichain selection, coding, category witnesses, and measure thinning are explicit.
